property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the DataMergePreference (a DataMerge).

property.name: leftMargin
property.shortdesc: The offset value of the left margin in the target document.

property.name: topMargin
property.shortdesc: The offset value of the top margin in the target document.

property.name: rightMargin
property.shortdesc: The offset value of the right margin in the target document.

property.name: bottomMargin
property.shortdesc: The offset value of the bottom margin in the target document.

property.name: arrangeBy
property.shortdesc: The order in which to arrange multiple records on the page in the target document.

property.name: rowSpacing
property.shortdesc: The amount of space between rows of records in the target document.

property.name: columnSpacing
property.shortdesc: The amount of space between columns of records in the target document.

property.name: recordNumber
property.shortdesc: The number of the record to merge. Note: Valid only when record selection is one record.

property.name: recordRange
property.shortdesc: The range of records to merge. Note: Valid only when record selection is range.

property.name: recordsPerPage
property.shortdesc: The number of records to place on each page in the document.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: alertMissingImages
method.shortdesc: If true, lists missing images in the specified output file.

parameter.name: outputMissingImagesReportFile
parameter.shortdesc: The path to the output file.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the DataMergePreference.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
